references.text: Gideon returns to Succoth after capturing Zebah and Zalmunna, and confronts the leaders with their earlier rejection
Gideon's request for bread for his exhausted men, which the leaders of Succoth refuse
Gideon's threat of punishment against the men of Succoth because of their rejection
A similar example of discouragement and rejection among Israelites who refused to support their brothers
Nabal refuses David's request for food and supplies in a manner similar to how the leaders of Succoth rejected Gideon
A mocking response that challenges someone's ability to achieve victory, similar to the doubt from the leaders of Succoth
